instruction: Hi! I'm HEXON. Welcome to Omarchy! Spend less time managing your desktop and operating system, and more time doing what matters. I'll help you get started. Your desktop - your way. Let's jump in!

instructions.ohm-1: Hi! I'm Ohm-1, but you can call me Ohm for short. Welcome to Omarchy! Spend less time managing your desktop and operating system, and more time doing what matters. I'll help you get started. Your desktop - your way. Let's jump in!

recommendation: Ready to get started? Choose from one of the following lessons.

controls.instruction: These are the Learn Omarchy controls: Settings, keyboard capture, mute narration, and Exit. Release the keys when you want to use other windows; capture them again to continue with me.
